evidence_type: provider tracking/event records; independently observed ground truth not available

tracking.period: nullable integer; audit separates 1/2 from other/null
tracking.possession.player_id: nullable metadata players[].id; sparse and not forward filled
tracking.possession.group: nullable team group string; not an observed change-of-possession guarantee
tracking.player_data[].x/y: nullable pitch-centred metres per provider README; finite checked
tracking.player_data[].is_detected: provider detection/extrapolation flag, not independent identity accuracy
tracking.ball_data: nullable XYZ and detection state; XY finite checked
tracking.image_corners_projection: provider camera-footprint estimate; no visibility guarantee inferred

events.frame_start/end: integer tracking references; every endpoint matched; time strings can differ
events.start_type: categorical; pass_reception is the measured reception category
events.attacking_side: provider direction by period/team; canonical geometry not validated
events.x/y: event scale/convention requires verified transformation before combining with tracking

pose.frame: 25 Hz; only integer shared ticks joined, no rounding
pose.xyz: joint XYZ values; pitch-centred per provider; global Z accuracy limited
pose.p90_mae_cm: provider predicted joint error in centimetres, not independently calibrated here

audit_metrics.frame_quality: counts of period-labelled frames, includes ball-out-of-play
audit_metrics.entry_quality: detected/extrapolated among present player entries; absent players excluded from denominator
audit_metrics.route_quality: possession-start listed-teammate endpoints and finite opponent corridor positions only
audit_metrics.raw_velocity: consecutive detected same-player 0.1s finite difference, m/s; unsmoothed
audit_metrics.eligible_episode_count: undetermined; point-quality counts are not complete sequences
